sources.title: Divergent Morphology among Populations of the New Guinea Crocodile, Crocodylus novaeguineae (Schmidt, 1928): Diagnosis of an Independent Lineage and Description of a New Species
sources.locator: Abstract; material examined; comparative morphology and species diagnosis.
sources.scope: Comparison of northern and southern New Guinea specimens; supports a morphology-based diagnosis of sampled groups and the description of C. halli, not complete island-wide population ecology.
sources.attribution: Murray CM, Russo P, Zorrilla A, McMahan CD (2019). Divergent Morphology among Populations of the New Guinea Crocodile, Crocodylus novaeguineae (Schmidt, 1928): Diagnosis of an Independent Lineage and Description of a New Species. Copeia 107(3):517–523. DOI 10.1643/CG-19-240. Claims are paraphrased.

claims.text: The comparison included northern specimens from the Sepik River and Hunstein; the sampled northern group differed in relative maxilla and postcranial proportions from southern groups described as C. halli.
claims.scope: Specimen-based morphology comparison, not a field identification key validated for all ages or river systems.

gaps: The specimen comparison does not inventory all New Guinea river populations or define all range boundaries.
The guide is not a multi-source species dossier.
